definitions.explanation: In a separate or individual manner; not together.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{別々|べつべつ}に{帰|かえ}った。
{書類|しょるい}は{別々|べつべつ}に{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。

notes:
{別々|べつべつ}に is the adverbial form of the na-adjective {別々|べつべつ}, meaning to do something separately or individually rather than together.

FORMS:
- {別々|べつべつ}な / {別々|べつべつ}の + noun: separate (as modifier)
- {別|べつ}: separate, different (single form, broader meaning)
- {別々|べつべつ}だ: to be separate (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {別々|べつべつ}に{払|はら}う: to pay separately
- {別々|べつべつ}に{住|す}む: to live separately
- {別々|べつべつ}に{行動|こうどう}する: to act independently
- {別々|べつべつ}の{道|みち}を{行|い}く: to go separate ways

USEFUL PHRASE:
お{会計|かいけい}は{別々|べつべつ}にお{願|ねが}いします means "Separate checks, please" — a practical phrase for dining out in Japan.
